selected_script.angle: Restless, overheated dog unable to settle on a hot rug, solved by instant passive cooling mat placement
selected_script.hook: A restless, panting dog shifts uncomfortably on a thick, stuffy rug, struggling to find a cool spot in the summer heat.

timeline.scene: Close-up of a panting, restless dog trying to lie down on a thick, hot living room rug but constantly shifting because it's too warm.
A hand suddenly tosses down the pale ice-blue Bedsure cooling mat directly over the rug, laying flat instantly.
The dog is now lying perfectly still on the soft wave-quilted pale blue mat, eyes closed, visibly cooled down and relaxed.
Quick cut to the same pale ice-blue mat placed neatly inside a wire dog crate, the dog sleeping peacefully on top.
Quick cut to the mat placed on hardwood floor near a sunny sliding door, dog lounging happily, showing the white edge piping and gray non-slip underside.
Text overlay appears: 'Your dog's cozy spot starts here.' Final shot of the resting dog.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life pain conflict with a dog panting heavily and shifting restlessly on a thick, hot rug. 3-6s: Quickly introduce the product as a direct solution; a hand places a pale ice-blue rectangular cooling mat with white edge piping flat onto the floor. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the dog lying peacefully on the soft wave-quilted pale blue mat, instantly relaxed. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Keep the product as a thin flat mat with rounded corners. Do not invent cords, gel, or electric parts. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Keep the pacing fast, clear, and product-focused.
